findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.cruiseregister.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_port, get_ship · Private data: get_transfers · Public sink: port_excursions, watch_sailing · Destructive: find_deals, get_line.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_port, get_ship · Private data: get_transfers · Public sink: port_excursions, watch_sailing · Destructive: find_deals, get_line

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
